diagnoses.label: Clickable overlay text blocks bubble interaction
diagnoses.observable_evidence: Location hint flags “可点击图形、覆盖文字层…验收部分”. In the provided bubble example, bubbles are circles with click handlers, but there is no guidance for adding ticker labels as an overlay text layer without intercepting pointer events; typical D3 pattern (circle + text) can cause text to capture clicks/hover instead of the circle.
diagnoses.mechanism_anchor: Interactive layering & pointer-events control for overlaid labels
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Applies when adding labels (e.g., ticker symbols) on top of clickable/hoverable marks (bubbles) in SVG.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Do not apply to non-overlaid elements (e.g., standalone text annotations outside marks) or non-interactive charts.
diagnoses.target_section: Interactive features (tooltips, click handlers, hover effects)
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Add explicit guidance and a canonical snippet: render labels in a separate text layer with `pointer-events: none` (or attach handlers to a parent <g>), ensuring hover/click targets remain the bubble/group; include CSS/SVG attribute recommendations.

diagnoses.label: Two-way linking mechanism is fragmented and inconsistent
diagnoses.observable_evidence: Bubble example uses `selectBubble(ticker)` and calls `highlightTableRow` if defined; table example uses `selectRow(ticker)` and calls `highlightBubble` if defined. Function names and responsibilities are mismatched (select vs highlight; bubble->table uses highlightTableRow, table->bubble uses highlightBubble), creating an integration gap for “双向联动验收”.
diagnoses.mechanism_anchor: Bidirectional selection state + shared dispatcher between chart and table
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Applies when a task requires coordinated interactions between multiple views (chart ↔ table) with consistent selection/highlight behavior.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Do not apply to single-view interactions (only chart or only table) where no cross-component synchronization is required.
diagnoses.target_section: Interactive features (tooltips, click handlers, hover effects)
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Define a single, named selection API pattern in the skill (e.g., `setSelectedTicker(ticker)` + `onSelectionChange(cb)` or a shared state object) and require both components to call the same function; clarify naming (select vs highlight) and expected CSS classes for selected state in both views.

diagnoses.label: Tooltip exclusion rule for ETFs is incorrect/underspecified
diagnoses.observable_evidence: Task requires: “ETF entries have no marketCap, country, or website data, so do not show tooltip for them”. Bubble example gates tooltip with `if (d.sector !== 'ETF')`, which conflates sector with instrument type and will fail if ETFs are not encoded as sector='ETF'. TooltipHandler example uses `d.category !== 'ETF'` similarly. Skill.md only shows a generic conditional interactivity example, not the specific robust rule (e.g., based on missing fields).
diagnoses.mechanism_anchor: Conditional tooltip gating based on data completeness/typed flags
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Applies when tooltip display must be conditional on data completeness or entity type (e.g., ETFs lacking fields).
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Do not apply to cases where all entities have complete tooltip fields or where exclusion is purely stylistic rather than data-driven.
diagnoses.target_section: Interactive features (tooltips, click handlers, hover effects) / Conditional interactivity
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Strengthen guidance to gate tooltips using explicit flags or field presence (e.g., `hasMarketCap` / `isETF` derived during parsing) rather than overloading `sector`/`category`; document a deterministic parsing step that sets these booleans.

overlay.primary_anchor: Interactive layering & pointer-events control for overlaid labels
overlay.composition_issue: Overlay label text can intercept pointer events, which then breaks both tooltip hover and click-to-select; the fragmented two-way linking further obscures whether failures come from event targeting vs. state synchronization.
preservation_constraints: Preserve determinism rules (no randomness; fixed tick counts/initial positions for force simulation).
Preserve offline dependency guidance (no CDN; pinned D3 version guidance) even if task requests v6.
Preserve existing tooltip best-practice pattern (CSS class toggling, pointer-events: none on tooltip div).

package_assessment.rationale: Defects are documentation/mechanism-pattern gaps inside SKILL.md (interaction layering, unified selection API, robust conditional tooltip gating). These can be corrected by strengthening reusable guidance without needing task-specific code or external dependencies.

repair_audit.target_anchor: Interactive layering & pointer-events control for overlaid labels
repair_audit.edit_kind: Add missing guidance/snippets for overlay label pointer-events, unify two-way linking selection API, and strengthen tooltip gating rule based on field presence/flags
repair_audit.boundedness: Positive: only expands the existing “Interactive features” section with concrete, reusable patterns for (1) overlaid SVG text labels on interactive marks, (2) consistent chart↔table selection via a single shared function, and (3) robust conditional tooltip gating based on derived booleans/field completeness. Negative: does not change determinism rules, offline dependency guidance, or any scripts/attachments; does not introduce task-specific file paths or end-task artifacts.
repair_audit.verification_plan: Downstream implementations should verify: (1) with circle+text labels, hover/click works even when cursor is over the text (text has pointer-events:none or handlers on parent g); (2) clicking bubble highlights exactly one table row and clicking row highlights exactly one bubble using the same setSelectedKey/renderSelection mechanism; (3) tooltip does not appear for rows lacking required fields (e.g., ETFs missing marketCap/country/website) by checking derived hasTooltipData rather than sector/category string comparisons.
